posts.name: Uday
posts.cooked:
Is is necessary to do the PPA, assignments, OPPE questions on the course VM or it is just for practice to get us familiar with the environment so we can give the OPPE easily ???

Are these all mentioned categories graded, non graded or just for practice as there is no deadline for any of the mentioned categories !!!

Kindly confirm this,

Thanks in advance.

posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked:
These are for practice only.

BPTs will be graded.

posts.name: Uday
posts.cooked: Apart from BPT, nothing is mandatory to submit, right ???

posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked:
On VM only BPTs and actual OPPE exam is mandatory.

And on portal GAs and Grpas are mandatory.

posts.cooked: Ok thnx for ur help
